6.1 Circle

blocks.prompt:
1 Define a circle, its centre and its radius.
(Circle, us ke centre aur radius ki definition likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Circle (daira) plane ke un tamam points ka set hai jo aik muqarrar point se muqarrar fasle par hon. Muqarrar point centre (markaz) aur muqarrar fasla radius (nisf qutr) kehlata hai.

book_ref.quote: A circle is the set of all points in a plane that are at a fixed distance from a given fixed point.

blocks.prompt:
2 What are degenerate conics? When are they obtained?
(Degenerate conics kya hain? Yeh kab bante hain?)
blocks.explanation: Jab kaatne wala plane cone ke vertex (chotti) se guzre to section aik point, aik seedhi line ya do kat-ti lines ka joda hota hai. Inhein degenerate conics kehte hain.

book_ref.quote: These happen when the slicing plane passes through the vertex A.

blocks.prompt:

(Centre \((4, -3)\) aur radius 6 wale circle ki equation maloom karein.)

book_ref.quote: Equation of a circle with centre at the point

blocks.text: 6.1.1 Parametric Equations of a Circle

book_ref.quote: Write an equation of the circle with centre

blocks.text: 6.1.2 General Form of an Equation of a Circle

blocks.prompt:
7 When does \(x^{2} + y^{2} + 2gx + 2fy + c = 0\) represent (i) a real circle (ii) a point circle (iii) no real locus?
(\(x^{2} + y^{2} + 2gx + 2fy + c = 0\) kab (i) real circle (ii) point circle (iii) koi real locus nahi hoti?)
blocks.explanation: (i) \(g^{2} + f^{2} - c > 0\): real circle; (ii) \(g^{2} + f^{2} - c = 0\): point circle; (iii) \(g^{2} + f^{2} - c < 0\): imaginary circle (koi real point nahi).

book_ref.quote: If \(g^{2} + f^{2} - c = 0\), equation (1) represents a point circle

blocks.prompt:

(\(k\) maloom karein taake circle \(x^{2} + y^{2} + 8x - 6y + k = 0\) ka radius 6 ho.)

book_ref.quote: which is the general form of the equation of a circle with centre

blocks.prompt:

(Dikhayein ke \(x^{2} + y^{2} - 6x + 2y + 15 = 0\) koi real circle nahi.)

book_ref.quote: If \(g^{2} + f^{2} - c < 0\), equation (1) represents no real locus

blocks.text: 6.1.3 Working Rule to Find the Centre and Radius of a Circle in General Form

(Circle \(9x^{2} + 9y^{2} - 36x + 6y - 107 = 0\) ka centre aur radius maloom karein.)

(Aik point is tarah chalta hai ke (2, 0) se us ka fasla (-1, 0) se fasle ka do guna hai. Dikhayein ke locus circle hai aur centre, radius maloom karein.)

blocks.text: 6.1.4 Equation of a Circle with Given End points of a Diameter

blocks.prompt:

(Jis circle ke diameter ke siray \((-1, 2)\) aur \((5, -6)\) hon, us ki equation maloom karein.)

book_ref.quote: This is the required equation of the circle.

blocks.prompt:

(Diameter AB wale circle ki equation nikalte waqt lines AP aur BP perpendicular kyun hain?)

book_ref.quote: Using the condition for perpendicularity of two lines

blocks.text: 6.1.5 Equations of Circles Determined by Given Conditions

blocks.prompt:
14 Why are three conditions needed to determine a circle?
(Circle muqarrar karne ke liye teen shartein kyun chahiye?)
blocks.explanation: General equation mein teen independent constants \(g\), \(f\), \(c\) hain; har shart aik equation deti hai, is liye teen shartein chahiye.

book_ref.quote: These can be determined if the equation satisfies three given conditions.

blocks.prompt:

(Centre \((1, -2)\) wala circle jo line \(5x + 12y + 6 = 0\) ko chhoota hai, us ki equation maloom karein.)
blocks.explanation: Radius = centre se line ka fasla \(= \frac{|5 - 24 + 6|}{13} = 1\). Circle: \((x - 1)^{2} + (y + 2)^{2} = 1\).

book_ref.quote: Case 4: A Circle Passing through Two Points and Touching a Given Line

blocks.prompt:
16 Find the equation of the circle passing through \((0, 0)\), \((6, 0)\) and \((0, -4)\).
(\((0, 0)\), \((6, 0)\) aur \((0, -4)\) se guzarne wale circle ki equation maloom karein.)

book_ref.quote: Infinitely many circles can pass through two points

blocks.text: 6.2 Tangent and Normal to a Curve

blocks.prompt:
17 Define the tangent and the normal to a curve at a point.
(Curve ke kisi point par tangent aur normal ki definition likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Jo line curve ko sirf aik point par chhooye woh tangent (mamas) hai, aur woh point point of contact hai. Point of contact par tangent ke perpendicular line normal (amood) kehlati hai.

book_ref.quote: If a line touches a curve at exactly one point, it is called a tangent to the curve

blocks.prompt:
18 Find the equations of the tangent and normal to the curve \(y = x^{2} - 2x\) at \((3, 3)\).
(Curve \(y = x^{2} - 2x\) ke point \((3, 3)\) par tangent aur normal ki equations maloom karein.)

book_ref.quote: The line perpendicular to the tangent at its point of contact is called the normal

(Rule ki madad se \(x^{2} + y^{2} + 6x - 4y - 12 = 0\) ke point \((1, 5)\) par tangent likhein.)

blocks.prompt:

(\(x^{2} + y^{2} + 2x - 6y + 6 = 0\) ke un points par tangents aur normals maloom karein jahan \(x = -1\).)
blocks.explanation: \(x = -1\): \(y^{2} - 6y + 5 = 0\), \(y = 1, 5\). Centre \((-1, 3)\): tangents \(y = 1\) aur \(y = 5\); dono points par normal \(x = -1\).

blocks.prompt:

(Kya \((-2, 4)\) circle \(x^{2} + y^{2} + 4x - 2y - 11 = 0\) ke bahar, upar ya andar hai?)

book_ref.quote: Find an equation of the line joining the points of contact

blocks.prompt:

(\((1, -2)\) se \(x^{2} + y^{2} = 4\) par kitne real tangents khenche ja sakte hain? Wajah batayein.)
blocks.explanation: \(1 + 4 - 4 = 1 > 0\): point bahar hai, is liye do real aur alag tangents.

book_ref.quote: The length of the tangent drawn from a point

blocks.text: 6.2.8 Rule to Find the Length of the Tangent

(Point se circle tak tangent ki lambai maloom karne ka rule likhein.)
blocks.explanation: (i) \(x^{2}\), \(y^{2}\) ke coefficients 1 karein. (ii) Right side zero karein. (iii) Point ke coordinates left side mein rakhein. (iv) Nateeje ka square root lein.

blocks.text: 6.3 Parabola

blocks.prompt:

(Parabola, us ke focus aur directrix ki definition likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Parabola us point ka locus hai jo plane mein is tarah chale ke us ka aik muqarrar point (focus) se fasla aik muqarrar line (directrix) se fasle ke barabar rahe.

book_ref.quote: A Parabola is the locus of a point which moves in a plane

blocks.text: 6.3.1 Standard Equation of the Parabola

blocks.prompt:

book_ref.quote: Thus, the focus of the parabola is

blocks.prompt:

(\(y^{2} = 8x\) par woh points maloom karein jin ka focal distance 10 ho.)

book_ref.quote: The distance of a point on the parabola from the focus is called its focal distance.

blocks.prompt:
38 Show that \((5t^{2}, 10t)\) lies on \(y^{2} = 20x\) for all real \(t\) and find the point for \(t = -2\).
(Dikhayein ke \((5t^{2}, 10t)\) har real \(t\) ke liye \(y^{2} = 20x\) par hai, aur \(t = -2\) wala point likhein.)

book_ref.quote: The point \((at^{2}, 2at)\) lies on the parabola for all real \(t\)

blocks.prompt:

(Parabola ke axis aur vertex ki definition likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Axis woh seedhi line hai jo focus se guzre aur directrix ke perpendicular ho. Vertex woh point hai jahan axis parabola ko milta hai.

book_ref.quote: The straight line through the focus and perpendicular to the directrix is called axis of the parabola.

blocks.text: 6.3.3 Other Standard Forms of the Parabola

blocks.prompt:

(Vertex \((2, 4)\) aur focus \((-1, 4)\) wale parabola ki equation maloom karein.)
blocks.explanation: Focus vertex se 3 unit baen: left khulta hai, \(a = 3\): \((y - 4)^{2} = -12(x - 2)\).

book_ref.quote: By taking the directrix on the right side of the focus, or below or above the focus

blocks.prompt:
46 Define an ellipse and state Kepler's first law.
(Ellipse ki definition aur Kepler ka pehla qanoon likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Ellipse plane ke un tamam points ka set hai jin ke do muqarrar points (foci) se faslon ka majmua constant ho. Kepler ka pehla qanoon: nizam-e-shamsi mein sayyaron ke madar ellipse hain.

book_ref.quote: An ellipse is the set of all points in a plane for which the sum of distances from two fixed points

blocks.text: 6.5 Hyperbola

blocks.prompt:
56 Define a hyperbola. How does its definition differ from that of an ellipse?
(Hyperbola ki definition likhein. Yeh ellipse ki definition se kaise mukhtalif hai?)
blocks.explanation: Hyperbola un tamam points ka set hai jin ke do muqarrar points (foci) se faslon ke farq ki absolute qeemat constant ho. Ellipse mein faslon ka majmua constant hota hai, hyperbola mein farq.

book_ref.quote: the absolute value of the difference between these distances is fixed

65 The cable of a suspension bridge hangs as a parabola. The span is 160 m and the tops of the towers are 40 m above the lowest point of the cable. Find the equation of the cable and its height above the lowest point 40 m from the centre.
(Suspension bridge ki cable parabola hai. Span 160 m hai aur towers ki choti cable ke sab se neeche wale point se 40 m upar hai. Cable ki equation aur centre se 40 m par us ki unchai maloom karein.)

blocks.prompt:
66 A satellite orbit is an ellipse with the Earth's centre at a focus; its semi-major axis is 10000 km and its eccentricity 0.1. Find its least and greatest distances from the Earth's centre.
(Satellite ka madar ellipse hai, Earth ka centre focus par; semi-major axis 10000 km aur eccentricity 0.1. Earth ke centre se kam se kam aur zyada se zyada fasla maloom karein.)
blocks.explanation: Kam se kam \(= a(1 - e) = 9000\) km; zyada se zyada \(= a(1 + e) = 11000\) km.
